title: Shockwave Medical at TCT 2026
clientLabel: Shockwave Medical, part of Johnson & Johnson
summary: An always-on filming booth on Shockwave Medical's stand at TCT 2026, capturing KOLs, physicians and leadership for Johnson & Johnson's IVL team.
body:
At TCT 2026 we worked with Johnson & Johnson's Shockwave Medical team, who make the intravascular lithotripsy (IVL) devices, on a dedicated filming booth set up for us on their stand.

We ran an always-on approach to filming with the client. Over the congress we captured key opinion leaders, physicians and members of Shockwave Medical's leadership team in single and two-person interviews on multiple cameras, alongside social media content with physicians.

Away from the interview set, we filmed B-roll of the stand and physician presentations around the booth, including a presentation on deliverability from a key physician, and took the team photo on the day.

TCT is part of our long-standing work with Shockwave Medical, now part of Johnson & Johnson, across European and US congresses.
